concept: Noticing when someone is being unkind, even if they're smiling or say they're joking
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character notices something feels unkind even though it was said with a smile or called 'just a joke'
exercise.reflection_prompt: How did the character tell the difference between a real joke and something that just seemed like one?
exercise.practice: Student sorts a few example statements into 'kind,' 'not kind,' and 'not sure — I'd ask a trusted adult'

assessment.success_marker: student correctly identifies at least one 'not sure' case and names it as worth asking an adult about
